tldr: Neptune in the 2nd house: longing becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Neptune in the 2nd house, this part of you sensitizes money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Neptune describes longing, imagination, sensitivity, compassion, confusion, and the places where boundaries soften. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Neptune can become empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence.
gift: empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
